class.name: FoundryBuildTaskConfigSchema
class.brief_description: Configuration schema returned by a script-backed build task provider.
class.description: Describes the provider-specific options accepted by a [FoundryBuildTask]. The schema is intentionally lightweight so providers can expose option metadata without participating in command execution or full pipeline gating.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the schema has no properties and no required option names.

members.member: Schema entries keyed by option name.
Option names that must be present for this provider.
